scope: Data-only review of artifacts/arka-native-v2/opus-train/{slack,transcribe,prompt,polish}.jsonl (63 rows) and opus-dev/{slack,transcribe,prompt,polish}.jsonl (16 rows). Every full input and output was read. No implementation, prior pilot, or judge scores were consulted.
dataset_findings: Row verdicts: pass 63, fail 6, uncertain 10 of 79.

Concrete defects: slack-12 output contains leaked 'MODE:/LANGUAGE:/INPUT:' meta text; prompt-05 drops the supplied quotes; polish-03 drops a fact; polish-15 changes the meaning; transcribe-19 keeps the 'Correction:' cue; transcribe-20 paraphrases indirect speech and questions.

The rows follow a rigid template. Every mode/split uses the same length tiers (train: 8 short under 350 chars, 4 medium 0.7–1.4k, 4 long 5.7–9.8k; dev: 2/1/1). Rows 02, 10, and 18 are the unchanged identity rows in every mode, 12 of 79 in total. Every identity row is a short, clean sentence, and no medium or long correct input is left unchanged.

Diversity is narrow. Non-English appears only in transcribe (de x2, pt x1). Context appears only as one fixed dictionary (transcribe-06/11/14) and one fixed polish profile string (polish-03/07/11/15/19). Slack, prompt, and polish are all English.

Most long inputs share one synthetic register: they repeatedly say 'not decided / don't assume / I haven't confirmed'. This over-represents uncertainty-preservation compared with natural messages. slack-19 is visibly padded, and prompt-12 contains an instruction to the formatter.

Policies are inconsistent across rows. Lowercase sentence starts are kept in slack-10 and transcribe-18 but fixed everywhere else. Slack article insertion is heavy in slack-20 and absent in slack-04/16. Spaced em dashes are kept in slack-03/09 but closed up in slack-11/15. The leading 'So' is dropped in transcribe-20 but kept in transcribe-12/15.
Correction cues in transcribe are mostly the formulaic 'X no Y' / 'no sorry' / 'no wait'. One ambiguous case (transcribe-09, pt 'domingo não na segunda-feira') has no explicit cue.
Facts, numbers, quotes, and dictionary terms are otherwise preserved with high accuracy, including in the very long rows. No /prompt output fulfills the task.
